# Explain that Stuff

> Free, accessible science and technology education resource offering beginner-friendly explanations of complex concepts from artificial intelligence to renewable energy.

Explain that Stuff is a comprehensive online educational platform created by author Chris Woodford that provides simple, jargon-free introductions to science and technology topics suitable for students, educators, and curious learners of all ages. The site emphasizes making complex subjects understandable through clear explanations and historical context.

## Key Topics

- artificial intelligence
- renewable energy
- climate change
- nuclear power
- solar cells
- space exploration
- physics
- STEM education
- beginner guides
- technology explanations
- science education
- engineering
- environmental science
- how things work

## Core Resources

- [Homepage](https://www.explainthatstuff.com): Main entry point for free science and technology education
- [A-Z Index](https://www.explainthatstuff.com/azindex.html): Comprehensive directory of all articles organized alphabetically
- [Timeline of Invention](https://www.explainthatstuff.com/timeline.html): Chronological history of scientific discoveries and technological inventions from 4000 BC to present
- [About Us & FAQ](https://www.explainthatstuff.com/aboutus.html): Information about the site, author Chris Woodford, and frequently asked questions
- [Author Profile](https://www.explainthatstuff.com/chris-woodford.html): Chris Woodford's author page with published books and credentials

## Energy & Environmental Science

- [How Do Solar Cells Work?](https://www.explainthatstuff.com/solarcells.html): Explanation of solar cell technology and photovoltaic energy conversion
- [How Does a Nuclear Power Plant Work?](https://www.explainthatstuff.com/how-nuclear-power-plants-work.html): Simple explanation of nuclear power plant operations and energy generation
- [How Heat Pumps Work](https://www.explainthatstuff.com/heatpumps.html): Guide to ground-source and air-source heat pump technology for heating and cooling
- [Global Warming for Kids](https://www.explainthatstuff.com/globalwarmingforkids.html): Easy-to-understand introduction to climate change causes and effects
- [What is Geoengineering?](https://www.explainthatstuff.com/geoengineering.html): Beginner guide to geoengineering and climate intervention solutions

## Technology & Innovation

- [Artificial Intelligence: A Simple Introduction](https://www.explainthatstuff.com/artificial-intelligence.html): Beginner guide to AI, machine learning, and intelligent systems
- [How Do Lasers Work?](https://www.explainthatstuff.com/lasers.html): Explanation of laser technology with history and practical applications
- [How Do Electric Cars and Hybrids Work?](https://www.explainthatstuff.com/electriccars.html): Guide to electric and hybrid vehicle technology and propulsion systems
- [Materials Science - A Simple Introduction](https://www.explainthatstuff.com/materials-science.html): Introduction to materials science and the properties of different materials

## Space & Physics

- [How Do Space Rockets Work?](https://www.explainthatstuff.com/spacerockets.html): Simple introduction to rockets, stages, and space exploration technology
- [Gravity: A Simple Introduction](https://www.explainthatstuff.com/gravity.html): Introduction to gravity from Newton's laws to Einstein's theory of relativity
- [History of Flight](https://www.explainthatstuff.com/history-of-flight.html): History of aviation from ancient myths to modern aircraft technology

## Educational Resources

- [Teaching Guide](https://www.explainthatstuff.com/teaching-guide.html): Curriculum guide for using Explain that Stuff articles in STEM education
- [Light Science for Kids](https://www.explainthatstuff.com/random.php): Beginner guide to light science and optics for young learners
